# Pi model metadata snapshot

Only JSON model metadata (43 files) extracted from @earendil-works/pi-ai 1.1.0, dist/providers/data. No published engine JavaScript is used at runtime.

Official npm tarball SHA-256: 6caab33cec57480ed02c57fe37428a030a77cc2a0662814b435a5cf8932ad829

This snapshot matches the imported source release and keeps offline builds reproducible. It is not model weights, API credentials or a promise of current model availability. `npm run source:models` explicitly refreshes the metadata and must be followed by build/check validation. Pi LICENSE applies.
